We want opposite: we want to accumulate long because uptrend continues? Or we want to avoid adverse sells? If sells are adverse, we should make ask higher (harder to sell). Positive skew when long makes ask lower (easier to sell) - opposite.

But if we are flat, skew does nothing.

Alternative: use negative skew => when long, r = mid - (-|skew|)*inv = mid + |skew|*inv => higher quotes. So long => higher bid/ask => buy more, sell less. That's momentum / trend-following.
